name: motion-preference
title: Motion preference
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A persisted choice of system, reduced, or full motion. Explicit choice wins over prefers-reduced-motion.

docs: Adapted from seamui's reduced-motion resolution (MIT, Mikhail Villamor). The hook works without a provider. MotionConfig reducedMotion never is ignored, matching seamui, because that value is motion's default. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
